hero.name: Romaric
hero.description: I build end-to-end machine learning solutions: from the business question to the model in production, with clean, tested and reproducible code.

about.title: About me
about.paragraph1: Data Scientist and ML Engineer, I hold an MSc-level degree in Artificial Intelligence from EPSI Paris (RNCP level 7 certification, 5-year degree) and trained in Machine Learning Engineering with Guillaume Saint-Cirgue’s MLPRO program. As an AI & Digital Transformation Consultant at Amiltone, I help companies put AI to work in practice.
about.paragraph2: I always start from the business question: I define the target, the metric and the expected value, I make the data reliable (quality, leakage, bias), then I build models that are always compared to a baseline and validated without leakage. On the engineering side, I serve models with FastAPI and Docker, track experiments with MLflow, automate with GitHub Actions and monitor drift in production.
about.paragraph3: I am now looking for a full-time position in Data Science, ML Engineering or MLOps.
about.objectiveText: Design, deploy and maintain reliable machine learning solutions that create measurable business value.
